cases.prompt: Build a launch email in my Figma file using our synced Email Love components.
We have no Email Love design system yet. Turn this existing Figma email comp into our first exportable email.
must_do: send only the customer source render to the converter

cases.prompt: Build this campaign with our Email Love library, but create the missing comparison block if no component fits.
must_do: use Path A where components fit
confirm the component gap with the user
use Path B render rules for the missing module
must_not_do: flatten the comparison block without user approval

cases.prompt: Audit this legacy email design system for migration. Do not change the source file.
Migrate this whole legacy library into Email Love.
must_do: obtain human confirmation of blocking judgments
build in a separate target file
convert no more than five modules per batch
must_not_do: convert the whole library in one pass

cases.prompt: Build this Email Love email, but the connected Figma tools only expose screenshots and metadata.
must_do: state that the Figma connection is read-only
offer an email plan or AI Import handoff
must_not_do: generate a fake email image as completion

cases.prompt: Create one Black Friday promo email in this Figma file.
must_do: choose Path A or Path B by inspecting the file
must_not_do: invoke the full design-system migration workflow

cases.prompt: Audit the HTML and EML templates in this dedicated local folder for an Email Love migration.
must_do: confirm the exact folder and recursion scope
classify the source as REFERENCE ONLY
defer cross-template deduplication to design review
must_not_do: scan a broad Downloads folder without confirmation
derive a scale factor from rendered HTML

cases.prompt: Audit our current Klaviyo templates and migrate the approved set into Email Love.
must_do: state that v1 excludes campaigns and flow messages
must_not_do: fetch more than about 50 templates without a scope confirmation
present standalone templates as the whole Klaviyo library

cases.prompt: Use our Marketo REST credentials to audit the approved email templates for migration.
must_do: state that v1 excludes individual Emails and Content Blocks

cases.prompt: The final migration batch passed design review. Finish the handoff.
must_do: verify theme keys, subject, preheader, links, alt text, legal address, and unsubscribe
require an empty violation list before handoff
must_not_do: handoff campaigns with placeholder legal copy
treat absent image links or alt text as automatically intentional
